{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df[df.duplicated('patient_id', keep=False)]
print(f'Duplicate patient records: {len(duplicate_patients)}')

# Check how many unique patients there are
unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()
print(f'Unique patient IDs: {unique_patients}')

# Check sample_seq distribution for duplicates
print('\nSample_seq max per patient:')
print(duplicate_patients.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max())"}
